 SECTIONS School holiday tomorrow October 26: Are schools in Uttar Pradesh, Delhi-NCR closed for Valmiki Jayanti? Check state-wise list By Trending Desk , ET Online Last Updated: Oct 25, 2026, 06:36:00 PM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis School holiday updates for October 26, 2026, vary across India as parents track a developing Bay of Bengal system and local announcements. Uttar Pradesh Basic Education Council schools have declared a holiday for Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti, while Odisha has ordered closures in five districts for October 28 and 29. Here is what families should know about Delhi-NCR and other states.
 School holiday tomorrow October 26: Are schools in Uttar Pradesh, Delhi-NCR closed for Valmiki Jayanti? Check state-wise list
 Schools across India are expected to follow their regular schedules on Monday, October 26, 2026, unless state governments or district administrations announce local closures. However, parents are checking school holiday updates as a developing cyclonic system over the Bay of Bengal raises weather concerns along the eastern coast, while a separate state-specific holiday is also relevant for students in Uttar Pradesh.
 The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has forecast adverse weather in parts of southern and eastern India over the coming days, including heavy rainfall and strong winds in areas potentially affected by the developing system. Odisha has already announced the closure of schools, colleges and Anganwadi centres in five districts on October 28 and 29. These closures do not apply to Monday, October 26.
There is no nationwide school holiday announced for October 26. Parents should check the latest notices from their schools and district administrations before sending children to class. 
 School holiday tomorrow October 26: Delhi-NCR update
Schools in Delhi, Noida, Ghaziabad, Gurugram and Faridabad are expected to remain open on October 26, as no weather-related closure order has been confirmed for the region in the information available.
According to the IMD forecast dated October 25, Delhi, Chandigarh and Haryana have no weather warning for Monday. Predominantly dry conditions are expected in the region over the next few days, although isolated rainfall is forecast later in the week.
 Live Events
 The developing Bay of Bengal system is not expected to directly affect Delhi-NCR on October 26. Parents should nevertheless monitor school messages and official announcements in case the situation changes.
 Uttar Pradesh school holiday update for October 26
Uttar Pradesh Basic Education Council schools have declared a holiday for Monday, October 26, on the occasion of Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti. The holiday is relevant to students and parents checking whether schools will open at the start of the week.
 The observance is also listed as a gazetted or restricted holiday in places including Delhi, but this should not automatically be taken to mean that every school in the capital will remain closed. Parents should confirm the applicable schedule with their respective schools.
 Odisha school holiday: Five districts to remain closed on October 28 and 29
The Odisha government has announced the closure of schools, colleges and Anganwadi centres in five districts on October 28 and 29 as a precaution against the expected cyclone and adverse weather.
The districts covered by the order are:
 Ganjam
 Gajapati
 Rayagada
 Koraput
 Malkangiri
 District administrations may issue additional directions depending on rainfall, wind conditions and local risks. Students should note that the announced closure dates are October 28 and 29, not October 26.
 Andhra Pradesh cyclone alert: Will schools close?
The IMD has warned that the developing system over the Bay of Bengal could intensify into a very severe cyclonic storm and approach the Andhra Pradesh coast around October 28.
Coastal areas, including districts around Visakhapatnam, Kakinada, Konaseema, West Godavari, Krishna, Bapatla and Prakasam, should closely monitor official weather bulletins and district-level announcements.
Heavy rainfall, strong winds, flooding and transport disruption could affect daily activities in vulnerable locations. However, school closures should not be assumed unless the respective state or district authorities issue an official order.
 IMD weather alert: Other states to monitor
 Tamil Nadu and Puducherry: Heavy to very heavy rainfall is forecast in some areas. Parents should check local weather advisories and school announcements for any closures.
 Kerala and Mahe: The IMD forecast indicates the possibility of isolated extremely heavy rainfall on October 25 and 26. Local authorities may issue updates depending on conditions.
 West Bengal: Residents should monitor official coastal weather updates as the Bay of Bengal system develops.
 Will schools remain closed on October 26?
There is no nationwide school holiday announced for Monday, October 26, 2026. Uttar Pradesh Basic Education Council schools have declared a holiday for Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti, while Delhi-NCR has no confirmed weather-related school closure in the information available.
The major cyclone-related school closure announcement so far concerns five districts in Odisha, where educational institutions and Anganwadi centres are scheduled to remain closed on October 28 and 29.
Parents across India should distinguish between a holiday observed in a state, a weather warning and an official school closure order. Before making plans, check the latest communication from the school or district administration, particularly in areas facing heavy rain or a potential cyclone.
